dead_ends.why_failed: a body containing a literal END marker compounds corruption on every re-emit; strict one-ordered-pair integrity plus body token refusal replaced it
universal-newline translation rewrote CRLF files wholesale, violating compiler-owns-only-the-block; raw bytes decode preserves outside content exactly

learned.claim: v0.3.0: sessions stateful by default - SessionStart hook hydrates, CLAUDE.md imports the bundle, /checkpoint wraps propose-dispose, and emit-agents makes any AGENTS.md reader stateful.
Managed-block emit into agent-auto-read files is an injection surface: marker tokens in model-authored state escaped the fence on re-emit and became permanent instructions. Now standing audit item 7.
Fence guards need two layers: reject marker tokens at write (distillates) AND refuse at emit (intent/control text comes from other tools and is not distillate-scanned).
A mechanical Stop-hook auto-checkpoint was rejected by design: distillates are model-authored and an honest one cannot be generated by a hook.
